task: Detect whether a horse is more likely than its odds imply to underperform relative to expectation.

odds_to_expected_band.description: Map off_odds to an expected finish band before race evaluation.

outcome_label.rule: actual_finish_position is meaningfully worse than expected_finish_band by a fixed predeclared margin

constraints: feature changes require candidate proposal and human approval
odds band changes require candidate proposal and human approval
underperformance margin changes require candidate proposal and human approval
